source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.title: Optional pentagon coherence diagram
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.source_content: The pentagon identity equates (1⊗Φ)(id⊗Δ⊗id)(Φ)(Φ⊗1) with (id⊗id⊗Δ)(Φ)(Δ⊗id⊗id)(Φ). The preceding text states that Φ acts from the left-parenthesized tensor product to the right-parenthesized one.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.note: Optional editorial aid, not a rendering defect. A module-category pentagon could show the five parenthesizations of four tensor factors, label the associativity arrows induced by Φ, and label the two composites with the two sides of the displayed identity; check arrow orientation against the stated convention that Φ maps left-parenthesized to right-parenthesized tensors.
